Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X Serco purchased 2,094,221 ordinary shares between 16–20 Nov 2026 at daily average prices of 284.5142p, 275.9592p, 265.0841p, 261.3997p and 265.9460p (price range 256.8p–286.4p). Since the Programme began on 11 Aug 2026 the Company has acquired 21,527,835 shares into treasury; following these transactions there are 952,767,714 ordinary shares in issue excluding treasury, 49,978,300 shares held in treasury and the voting rights denominator is 952,767,714.
